owner_selective_solve.description: Owner-only Solve button on selected tests to trigger AI solution generation only for missing explanations while preserving owner/existing solutions.
owner_selective_solve.ui_pattern: Compact pill button with Wand2/Sparkles icon in maroon tone, status indicator showing missing count, and idempotent trigger with toast notifications.

one_line_question_report.description: Small, single-line reporting strip on every question across attempt, results, and solutions views.

active_attempt.style: Minimal distraction-free footer bar under question stem with a subtle 'Report issue' trigger.
active_attempt.behavior: Non-modal / expandable 1-line drawer or prompt. Must NOT leak answer keys or interrupt timer.

after_result.style: Inline banner in question review header next to marks/status badge.
after_result.behavior: Subtle 1-line link 'Report incorrect question/key' with categorical feedback.

solutions_view.style: Compact bar at bottom of matched solution / AI solution card.
solutions_view.behavior: Quick 1-line flag for solution typo or math error.

simplified_navigation.pattern: Hierarchical back-context breadcrumbs (Test Hub -> Test Detail -> Active Attempt -> Results Summary -> Question Solutions) with sticky progress headers and clear step restoration.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly preserve brand maroon (#5C0025) and typography (Figtree and Roboto Mono).
Ensure every interactive and key reporting element has kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Do not break or leak answer keys in active practice attempts during question reporting.
Owner solve button must only act on missing solutions, maintaining existing AI and human-edited solutions intact.
Keep navigation clear and focused with consistent breadcrumb anchors across Player, Results, and Studio.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML select/inputs.
Layer cards with crisp 1px borders (border-zinc-200 or border-[#5C0025]/15) and subtle shadows.
Use specific element transitions rather than transition: all.
Maintain high APCA contrast for legibility across light and dark surfaces.
